name: Dev Tools
description: A lightweight dev toolset under 200KB — instant to use. Sandboxed and offline with zero network access. High-frequency tools for crypto, encoding, text, data conversion, formatting, time, networking and image generation; inputs and options are remembered and sync seamlessly across devices via DBX.
releaseNotes: 新增：图像工具一键复制图片到剪贴板（需 DBX ≥ 0.7.0）——二维码、条码生成器、占位图、图片转 Base64（解码侧）新增「复制图片」按钮，非 PNG 格式自动转码；旧版宿主自动隐藏按钮。 | New: one-click copy-to-clipboard in image tools (requires DBX ≥ 0.7.0) — QR code, barcode generator, placeholder image and Base64-to-image gain a Copy Image button, with automatic PNG re-encoding for other formats; the button is hidden on older hosts.

zh-CN.name: Dev 工具集
zh-CN.description: 不到 200KB 的轻量开发者工具集，即开即用。沙箱离线运行，零网络权限。涵盖加解密、编解码、文本处理、数据转换、格式化、时间计算、网络运维、图像生成等众多高频工具；参数自动记忆，配置可随 DBX 跨端无缝同步。
